hints.title: Prefix Window Offset
hints.text: Index i must satisfy i <= j - indexDifference. As j increases, new valid indices i enter the available prefix.

hints.title: Maintain Prefix Extrema
hints.text: Track the index of the minimum value and the index of the maximum value in the prefix 0..j - indexDifference.

hints.title: Candidate Check
hints.text: At each step j, compare nums[j] against both prefix min and prefix max. If difference exceeds valueDifference, return the matching pair.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass maintaining running minimum and maximum prefix indices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use running prefix min/max pointer to solve in linear time.
